item_name: Sabre Personal Alarm with Led Light
item_short_desc: Stay safe on your next run with the ability to scare off an attacker or call for help with the SABRE Clip-On Personal Alarm with LED Safety Light.
description: Stay safe on your next run with the ability to scare off an attacker or call for help with the SABRE Clip-On Personal Alarm with LED Safety Light. The 120dB siren is extremely loud and is audible up to 1,300 feet (395 meters), helping to deter an attacker and help you to escape to safety. A bright, eye catching LED light helps to make you more visible on walks and runs. 3 LED light modes (always on, slow flash and fast flash) help you to stand out and stay safe while running through neighborhoods, streets and trails. Weatherproof and sweatproof design makes this personal alarm the perfect companion for runs in any weather. Compact, minimalist design is discreet and does not distract you during workouts. Convenient, built-in clip attaches onto athletic apparel and bags so it’s easy to carry everywhere.
